label: Supply chain of the lockfiles
description: Reads the npm and Python lockfiles offline for provenance and package-execution signals (install scripts, missing integrity hashes, registries that are not public or not pinned, git sources without a pinned commit, deprecated packages). Comes in by evidence: only when package-lock.json, npm-shrinkwrap.json, poetry.lock or Pipfile.lock exists at the root of the workspace or of a component. What the offline read cannot decide is reported as unknown, never as clean. Nothing is installed or downloaded.
